prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on what you need (short social ads vs TV spots, human avatar vs stock-footage templates, budget, languages, scale). Below are top choices by use case and what they’re good at (based on tools widely used through mid‑2024).

Top picks (short summary + when to pick them)
- Synthesia — Best for AI spokesperson videos and multi‑language voiceovers. Great when you want a realistic human avatar to deliver your script. Pros: fast, polished, enterprise features. Cons: less control over complex visuals, cost per minute/seat.
- HeyGen (formerly Movio) / Colossyan / Elai.io — Alternatives to Synthesia for avatar‑led ads; good variety of avatars and voices, often slightly different pricing/features.
- Runway — Best for creative, generative visuals and advanced video editing (background replacement, frame‑level effects, Gen‑style models). Pick this if you want custom, eye‑catching visuals beyond templates.
- Pictory — Best for repurposing long-form content into short social clips and automated captioning/transcripts. Good for content teams that turn blog/podcast into ads.
- InVideo / Lumen5 / Designs.ai (Videomaker) — Best for fast, template‑driven social ads: easy drag‑and‑drop, lots of templates, good stock libraries, affordable for small teams.
- Kapwing — Good all‑rounder for collaborative editing and quick social formats, subtitles, resizing for different platforms.
- Promo.com — Best for ad-focused stock footage + licensed music and ready‑made ad templates for platforms like Facebook/Instagram.
- Descript — Best if you need detailed audio editing, overdub voices and quick transcript‑based edits (useful if your ad is voice/narration driven).

How to choose
- Goal: human spokesperson? Choose Synthesia/HeyGen/Colossyan. Purely visual/template ad? InVideo/Lumen5/Promo. High‑end creative? Runway.
- Budget: Template tools (InVideo, Lumen5, Designs.ai) have lower entry cost; avatar and enterprise tools (Synthesia, Runway enterprise) cost more.
- Scale & localization: For many versions/languages, pick tools with multi‑language TTS and API/enterprise features (Synthesia, HeyGen).
- Speed vs control: Templates are fast; Runway/Descript let you fine‑tune visuals and audio.
- Platform requirements: Ensure the tool supports aspect ratios and ad specs for your target platforms and exports required codecs.

If you want a straightforward recommendation
- For quick, polished social ads (templates + stock): try InVideo or Promo.com.
- For personalized spokesperson ads or multilingual promos: try Synthesia or HeyGen.
- For standout, custom visual effects: try Runway.

If you tell me:
- your budget (free/under $50/mo/pro/enterprise),
- target platform(s) and ad length,
- whether you need a human avatar or stock footage,
I can recommend 1–2 specific tools and a simple workflow to get your first ad produced.
